_ghi_chu: Luat chuyen huong (Cloudflare Redirect Rules / Single Redirects) thay cho Worker letuanviet-www-redirect.
Luat chay TRUOC Worker, khong tinh vao han 100.000 yeu cau/ngay cua goi Workers mien phi (dung chung voi Worker quantri cua SEO-Agent).
Moi vung (zone) mot luat. Goi Free cho phep 10 luat moi vung.
Tao tren dashboard: vung -> Rules -> Overview -> Create rule -> Redirect Rule, dan bieu thuc 'expression' va 'target_url.expression' ben duoi.
Hoac qua API (token can quyen Zone > Single Redirect: Edit): PUT /zones/<zone_id>/rulesets/phases/http_request_dynamic_redirect/entrypoint voi body {"rules": [luat]}.
Ngoai le xac minh Google: letuanviet.digital/google49ce971bbd8cd1d5.html KHONG bi chuyen huong, Worker letuanviet-google-verification van tra loi duong dan do.
Quay lai cach cu: tat (Disable) hai luat; Worker letuanviet-www-redirect va route cua no van con nguyen cho toi khi go route.

rule.description: letuanviet.digital ve letuanviet.com, tru tep xac minh Google
rule.expression: (http.host eq "www.letuanviet.digital") or (http.host eq "letuanviet.digital" and http.request.uri.path ne "/google49ce971bbd8cd1d5.html")
